name: player_unbind_current_save_state_if_single_player
description: Player::UnbindCurrentSaveStateIfSinglePlayer clears the current player-state binding only when network play is disabled.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x406430 verifies a zOpt::GetNetworkEnabled gate, clearing g_CurrentPlayerSaveState->playerState offset 0x510 and then clearing g_CurrentPlayerSaveState only when network is disabled. The native smoke covers disabled and enabled network paths.
